name: Deep Learning-Based Super-Resolution for Volumetric Isosurfaces
aliases: FRVSR-Net / Deep Learning-Based Super-Resolution for Volumetric Isosurfaces
definition: A method to upscale low-resolution volumetric isosurface renderings to high resolution using a trained neural network, leveraging temporal coherence via screen-space flow warping and predicting intermediate surface attributes (mask, normal, depth, ambient occlusion) rather than direct color.
